iterations.strategy: Root cause: Category B+C. Thread-local hash maps were 100x oversized — 256K slots × 16B × 64 threads = 256MB, far exceeding 44MB LLC. Only ~106K lineitem rows qualify (partkey 1.1% × shipdate 16%), yet each thread allocated 4MB maps, causing 256MB init writes + 59ms merge scanning 16M slots. Fix: replace thread-local hash maps with thread-local vectors that collect qualifying (partkey, suppkey, qty) tuples — 26KB per thread vs 4MB. After parallel scan, build a single global hash map from ~106K collected tuples (~1.7MB, fits L2) in one pass — eliminates merge entirely. Also parallelize filter_part (22ms) across 64 cores. Expected: lineitem scan drops to ~15-20ms (bandwidth-limited on ~1.2GB with 64 cores), aggregate <1ms, filter_part <2ms, total ~20ms.
